{{Quote|Whoo-hoo-hoo! You dusted him!|Vedd Deviss, to Gavyn Sykes, at the start of Deviss's attack run on the enslavement camps|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
A number of [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] camps were '''liberated''' during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]], along with [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] enslavement drivers, had quickly established a number of these enslavement gcamps to hold [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|civilians]] after securing the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. [[Pilot/Legends|Pilots]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] liberated several such camps along the [[Andrevea River]]. After [[Disruption of Comm 4|disrupting]] and then [[Attack on disabled base|raiding]] a [[Trade Federation base]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]], under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]], used a captured [[Ostracoda-class gunboat|gunboat]] to infiltrate the camps and knock out the [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]], disabling the camps and freeing the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]].

[[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], the leader of a [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|criminal empire]] and an ally of the Security Force contingent led by Sykes and Captain Kael, provided [[Borvo the Hutt's freighter|transports]] on which the civilians could escape, but Sykes was forced to lead a surplus of civilians to sanctuary himself before meeting back up with Kael. When Sykes' [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] reached the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Ferentina]], the Federation forces [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] the river and attacked Ferentina, forcing the civilians to switch to [[Seraph-class urban landspeeder|Flash speeders]] while Sykes took to the air in an [[N-X Police Cruiser/Legends|N-X cruiser]] and escorted the convoy past the blockade to the planned rendezvous point near the [[Devils tower]] landmark.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Sykes, you've just been drafted into the Trade Federation.|Captain Kael orders Lieutenant Gavyn Sykes to steal a gunboat from the Trade Federation base|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
The [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> and established a number of [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] camps to hold captured [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] under the control of [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] enslavement drivers. During the course of the invasion, the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] struck several blows against the invaders after the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Naboo, [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], [[Capture of Theed/Legends|fell]]. After [[Disruption of Comm 4|disrupting]] and [[Attack on disabled base|attacking]] one [[Trade Federation base]], a [[Naboo Resistance|resistance band]] led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]] stole a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Ostracoda-class gunboat|gunboat]] to infiltrate several of the enslavement camps and release the [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] Naboo civilians.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==The battle==
===Infiltration===
{{Quote|Captain Kael, I've found the mining camp. The Trade Federation is using captured Naboo as slaves.''"<br />"''Do as much damage as you can and free the prisoners.|Lieutenant Gavyn Sykes and Captain Kael|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
Traveling along the [[Andrevea River]] in the stolen gunboat, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] infiltrated the enslavement camps at night. He reported to his flight lead, Captain Kael, who told Sykes to continue upriver and [[Scout/Legends|scout]] for Federation forces. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces had blocked the river with [[Proximity mine/Legends|proximity mines]], but Sykes was able to clear his way through. Several [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] flew overhead, however, and Sykes panicked. His flight leader managed to calm him down, warning him not to betray the mission. Sykes then arrived in a large bay area, where some of the camps were located, and Kael ordered him to free the prisoners. Since Sykes was in a Trade Federation gunboat, the forces stationed there believed him to be an ally. Two [[Unidentified minelayer|minelayers]] attempted to block the entrance with more proximity [[Mine/Legends|mines]], but Sykes shot them down and revealed himself. [[Laser turret (Trade Federation)|Laser turrets]] opened fire on the gunboat, but Sykes destroyed the [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]], shutting off the [[Laser/Legends|lasers]] and allowing the civilians to escape. That also prevented the first set of camps from sending out a warning to the other camps. Kael contacted Sykes and notified him that their [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] ally [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] was sending [[Borvo the Hutt's freighter|transports]] from his [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|smuggling organization]] to evacuate the civilians in the area.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

[[File:Devissstrafing.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Vedd Deviss attacking the power generator]]
As Sykes traveled further down the river, he saw another gunboat racing away to warn the rest of the camps. Sykes caught up to it and sank it, keeping his true identity hidden from the remaining Federation forces. He had to destroy more mines on the way to the central concourse, though he had no difficulties in passing through the gates of the concourse until he sneaked up to the [[Anti-aircraft weaponry|anti-air defenses]]. The defensive posts were alerted to his presence when Sykes opened fire on them. As he fought through the turrets, more gunboats were launched from the camp's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], and he also had to take out the anti-air turrets so that his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]] [[Vedd Deviss]] could arrive and destroy the generators. After Sykes destroyed the turrets with his gunboat's weapons, Deviss flew low in a strafing run in his [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]] to knock out the generators. The prisoners had been freed, but the resistance did not have enough [[Transport/Legends|transports]] to take them away, so the civilians found several [[Naboo houseboat|houseboats]] in which to travel, and Sykes escorted them further up the river to where they could meet back up with Kael and the rest of the group.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

===Sanctuary===
{{Quote|Okay, I'll get this convoy to the ruins. Let's move.|Lieutenant Gavyn Sykes, leading a convoy of rescued prisoners|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
As dawn broke, Sykes and the civilians approached the end of the river near the [[City/Legends|town]] [[Ferentina]], which was under attack by [[Trade Federation droid bomber]]s. A bomber [[Proton bomb/Legends|knocked out]] a bridge crossing over the river, trapping the [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] behind the bridge. The [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] stationed along the banks of the river subsequently opened fire on the transports. Sykes, knowing that his group had to take to the land, got to a water-based security hangar and took to the skies in an [[N-X Police Cruiser/Legends|N-X Police Cruiser]]. He destroyed the [[Tank/Legends|tanks]] and then knocked out a tunnel through which additional tanks had been traveling to join the battle. As the civilians were loaded into [[Seraph-class urban landspeeder|Flash speeders]], Sykes flew over the town to provide support, and he rescued two more crewed Flash [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] that were stuck behind a fallen tower. Sykes then advanced into the canyon ahead of the speeders, destroyed a [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of five tanks, and defended the convoy from many [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]], successfully escorting the convoy northward to an old hiding place in a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] pass near [[Devils tower]], an ancient landmark.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo}}
Sykes also found rapid-fire laser technology hidden behind Devils tower. Flying around the landmark, he picked it up.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />
{{Endgame}}

[[File:Ruinsrendezvous.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The rendezvous point]]

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Where's Captain Kael?''"<br />"''I'm not sure. I was separated from the Hutt's transports, but I think he went down. I'm sorry, sir.''"<br />"''Don't worry, Hollis. I'm sure the Captain survived. Let's find him before the Trade Federation does.|Lieutenant Gavyn Sykes and Lutin Hollis|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
As the civilians waited for transport, Sykes collapsed the rock bed behind them and then landed to take one of the speeders he had escorted. [[Lutin Hollis/Legends|Lutin Hollis]], another member of Sykes' resistance band, contacted him and said that Kael had been shot down and was missing. While Sykes believed that the captain was okay, he quickly joined in the [[Search for Captain Kael|search]] for Kael.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> The incident was later mentioned in a report given to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] by the leader of the invasion, [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]].<ref name="EG">{{StoryCite|story=End Game|book=Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|bformatted=''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization, 2012 edition}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The liberation of the enslavement camps is comprised of two successive missions&mdash;numbers eight and nine, appearing in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. In the ninth mission, it is possible to find an upgrade floating behind Devils tower, and picking it up will achieve this bonus objective.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> The liberation was mentioned in Sykes' entry in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III||Sykes, Gavyn}}</ref> and was also mentioned in the [[2011]] magazine [[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 62|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 62]].<ref name="OSVC 62">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 62|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 62]]</ref> The event was also mentioned in the [[2012]] short story "[[End Game]]," written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="EG" /> Page three of the storyboards of mission eight by artist [[James Zhang]] was also included in the 2008 behind-the-scenes book ''[[Rogue Leaders: The Story of LucasArts]]''.<ref name="Rogue Leaders">''[[Rogue Leaders: The Story of LucasArts]]''</ref>
